final: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_filled FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_filled) AS avg_all FROM order_avgs), kept AS (SELECT a.ordersmark, a.avg_filled, a.avg_filled - o.avg_all AS diff_overall FROM order_avgs a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.avg_filled > o.avg_all), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_filled) AS avg_kept FROM kept) SELECT k.ordersmark, k.avg_filled, k.diff_overall, k.avg_filled - ka.avg_kept AS diff_kept FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka ORDER BY diff_kept DESC LIMIT 10
